author: T. M. Chen
title: VBSchools celebrates nurses, teachers, and military families in May 6 social media posts
text:
Virginia Beach City Public Schools (VBSchools) recognized key members of its educational community in a series of posts on May 6, 2026. The school division highlighted the contributions of school nurses, celebrated a special moment for a military family, and showcased student gratitude toward teachers.
In an early morning post, VBSchools marked National School Nurse Day by expressing appreciation for its nursing staff. The tweet stated: “Happy #SchoolNurseDay!
#WeAreVBSchools #VBCPSCelebrates https://t.co/KKiVrFJsQZ” (May 6, 2026).
Later that morning, VBSchools shared news of a surprise reunion at Arrowhead Elementary School involving a military family. The post read: “Arrowhead Elementary student Clara N. got the best surprise ever on Tuesday when her dad surprised her with a visit after returning home from deployment!
Thank you to the school staff for helping make this special moment possible for this awesome military family! https://t.co/LyTWlE6G69″ (May 6, 2026).
In the evening, VBSchools posted about Teacher Appreciation Week activities. The tweet stated: “Our teachers make an impact every day, and this is our way of saying thank you from our students.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel→ https://t.co/CuIHLauASp” (May 6, 2026).
Virginia Beach City Public Schools is one of Virginia’s largest school divisions and regularly highlights milestones and events involving its staff and students through social media platforms.
